structured.rankingRationale: Top-ranked: Toronto Spotlight (explicit stay-to-play mechanism), The Mo Cup (multi-team recurring tournament with published growth), TOP Showcase (Toronto venue and large family/scout audience), then the national swimming and badminton events. Lower-ranked monitor items have committed competing hotels or venues farther from Harbourfront.

notesForDeepResearch: Verify official housing/partner-hotel contacts and whether Radisson Blu can be added for overflow or participant-arranged demand.
For committed hotel venues, investigate future edition rotation and overflow only with organizer evidence.
Prioritize Toronto Spotlight and The Mo Cup because they have explicit tournament lodging/recurring buying mechanisms or multi-team evidence.
materialUncertainties: Most candidates do not publish room blocks or attendance; no room demand is estimated.
The hotel restaurant/lounge and current catering capability were not assumed.
Several events are at committed competing hotels or distant venues; those are future-capture/monitor opportunities, not open current inventory.
Toronto Spotlight is a Toronto-area multi-venue event, not a Harbourfront/downtown-only event.
The Toronto swimming championship begins at Toronto Pan Am Sports Centre; its open-water component is in Gravenhurst and is not included as Toronto activity.
